cost.title: How much does it cost?
cost.description: Projects and audits are fixed price, agreed before we start. Ongoing work is billed monthly. No surprises on the invoice.

developer.title: We already have a developer doing this.
developer.description: That's usually how it starts — until they're stuck between shipping features and fixing fires. We take infrastructure off their plate and leave it documented, so they're never the only one who knows how it works.

availability.title: You're a small team. What if someone's out?
availability.description: Everything we build is automated and documented — nothing lives in one person's head. And we're upfront about limits: we don't sell 24/7 on-call.
